def fit(F, v, robust):
    w = np.linalg.lstsq(F, v, rcond=None)[0]
    for j in range(35 if robust else 0):
        e = np.linalg.norm(v - F @ w, axis=1)
        q = 1 / np.maximum(e, 0.00025)
        w = np.linalg.lstsq(F * q[:, None] ** 0.5, v * q[:, None] ** 0.5, rcond=None)[0]
    return w
